name: Lelon Electronics Corp.
summary: Lelon Electronics Corp., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, markets, trades in, and sells electrolytic capacitors internationally. Its electrolytic capacitors include aluminum electrolytic capacitors, such as radial type, SMD, snap-in terminal, screw terminal, and axial; organic conductive polymer capacitors; conductive polymer hybrid capacitors; and flame retardants. The company produces and sells formed aluminum foils and automatic manufacturing equipment. Its products are used in various applications, including automotive electronics, telecommunication, cloud computing, and power electronics. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwa…
